coverage.text_review: Exhaustive review of learner-facing blocks in regular and remediation steps, including code examples, annotations, recap/up-next text, nested before/after content, media summaries and bridges.
coverage.interaction_sampling_method: Within each tile, select the first interaction and every third interaction thereafter in lesson order. Review sampled prompts, options and visible workspace content.

basis.method: Compared each step against its concept context, prerequisites, blocked_future_concepts and glossary-taught facts; did not consult generator reasoning or rerun deterministic gates.
conclusions: No reviewed text or sampled interaction requires understanding a blocked future concept beyond the facts explicitly included in the current concept.

Basic arithmetic in assignment, numeric comparisons and print/type in core types, input in while loops, None in return values, globals in scope, and managed CSV opening in file_io are included in their respective glossary facts, not leakage into later dedicated concepts.
Up-next references are previews, not prerequisites for following the present step.

The simulated-input scaffold in learn_python.tile.006_007.s07 uses later syntax, but the prompt explicitly tells learners to leave that setup unchanged; the requested work requires only input, assignment, comparison and while-loop behavior. Its implementation need not be understood.
